Name: (CP) Bathroom after Houseupgrade
Author: zoelooy
Description:
Bathroom after Houseupgrade
升级后添加一间浴室

It's under the kitchen and the cellar entrance is on the left
在厨房下方，地窖入口在左边

You can use vanilla flooring and wallpaper
可以使用原版的地板和壁纸

There is no conflict with the addition of rooms in the FarmHouse
不会和农舍增加房间冲突

Can independently hide staircase covers and decorations
可以独立隐藏楼梯遮罩和装饰物

[size=5][b]兼容性(Compatible):[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526]Lnh's First FarmHouse[/url]﻿ : 兼容(Compatible)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411]Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse[/url]﻿: 兼容但是不支持模组自带的换颜色(Compatible but does not support the module's built-in recoloring.)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5104]Cellar Available[/url]﻿: 兼容(Compatible)

[*][size=2]兼容所有重新着色(Compatible with all recolors)[/size]

[/list][size=5][b]问题和修复(BUG&Fix)
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]If you encounter issues with Spouse Rooms/Cellar Stairs, you need to install "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿" to resolve this problem.
如果你遇到配偶房或地窖入口出现问题，你需要安装“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url]﻿”来解决这个问题
[*][s]Perhaps it's because I'm using some tilesheets that aren't commonly used, which is why recolors aren't provided or modified. [/s]
[s]This will be fixed in subsequent updates.
可能是我用了不常用的地图块，换贴图可能会导致部分图块出现问题，后续会修复
[/s]The current issue can be solved by changing the style of the bathroom corner pillars.
现在可更换浴室墙角柱子风格解决这个问题

[/list]

Downloads.Description:
The issue where the decorations disappeared when "FarmHouse LV1 Add Bathroom" was set to false has been fixed.
Now, you can change the style of the bathroom corner pillar.
修复了“一级农室添加浴室”为false时二级农室装饰物消失的问题
现在可更换浴室墙角柱子的风格

Add support for 'Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse' and 'Cellar Available'.
添加“Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse”和“Cellar Available”的兼容支持
